dialogues.speaker: Enghiene
dialogues.text: Turenna! Through this wargame... no, through all your years of training, you've truly come into your own as a member of the Special Security and Surveillance Patrol.

dialogues.speaker: Enghiene
dialogues.text: It's time for you to teach the new recruits.

dialogues.speaker: Turenna
dialogues.text: M—Me...? Wow, um, I'll have to prepare myself mentally...

dialogues.speaker: Enghiene
dialogues.text: Prepare yourself well! Someday, you'll be their drillmaster.

dialogues.speaker: Enghiene
dialogues.text: Yes, you, Turenna! You're well-versed in both combat and training. You've arrested a two-digit number of criminals, taken down a four-digit number of monsters, and you have a grand total of seven service medals to your name...

dialogues.speaker: Enghiene
dialogues.text: You don't have to show off, but be sure to keep your recruits in line, and keep them working hard!

dialogues.speaker: Turenna
dialogues.text: Knocking criminals out and hunting monsters is nothing compared to dealing with my coworkers...

dialogues.speaker: Turenna
dialogues.text: Um... In any case, I'll do my best!
